policies.n: Visa required for ordinary short tourism under the embassy explicit foreign-national default. Issuance method depends on consular jurisdiction and the LIS embassy-country criterion; nationality alone does not establish the online-arrival branch. LIS says to apply directly at the embassy if one exists in your country, without clearly distinguishing nationality from residence. If LIS confirms eligibility for its online-arrival process, obtain the approved QR confirmation before travel, enter at Roberts International Airport (ROB), then complete biometrics and collect the visa sticker. Approval is valid for entry within three months, not a three-month stay. The officer sets visit permission (portal describes 30 or 90 days); no common duration is assigned. No foreign residence or approval is assumed; this does not claim eVisa/arrival issuance is unavailable.
policies.label: Visa required; issuance method conditional

policies.n: Ordinary national passport: explicitly named in CAAB AIP GEN 1.3-1 visa-exempt list for stays up to 90 days. The October 2026 amendment checklist retains this page. Nationality-based exemption, not a visa-fee waiver or diplomatic-passport concession. Entry declarations and ordinary admission checks remain applicable.

CAAB AIP GEN 1.3-1 explicitly refuses admission and transit to nationals of Israel. The October 2026 amendment checklist retains this provision. This records the stated nationality restriction, rather than inferring a ban from a missing application option.
policies.label: Admission and transit refused

policies.n: Ordinary passport: the current-retained CAAB AIP states a visa-required default outside its named exemptions. Obtain an advance mission-issued sticker visa unless an actual conditional arrival-permission branch applies. Special Branch permits justified VOA applications by citizens arriving from countries without a Bangladesh embassy, and also describes arrivals from another country without a Bangladesh embassy; departure/residence is not assumed. Eligible applicants must follow online VOA pre-application/acknowledgement and final border issuance. The AIP additionally describes discretionary international-airport tourist/business landing permission up to 15 days with return air tickets, while the current police VOA product allows up to 30 days. These are not a uniform stay or unconditional walk-up entitlement; d=0 preserves the unresolved product-specific grant. Washington expressly says an eVisa has not yet been introduced; an online form is not itself a visa. Ancestry/NVR, diplomatic status and foreign residence are not assumed.
policies.label: Visa required; conditional arrival permissions

policies.n: Vatican City ordinary passport is expressly named in the CAAB AIP visa-exempt list for up to 90 days. Amendment 04/2026 retains this page. This specific exemption replaces the earlier generic Europe-based VOA classification; it is not a fee exemption.

Serbian ordinary passport: federal Iraqi visa required; the MFA identifies Embassy Belgrade processing. No short-tourist stay duration is established here, and electronic-channel availability is not determined. A Kurdistan Regional Government permit is region-only and cannot authorize travel to other parts of Iraq. Regional guarantor arrangements and registration requirements are separate.
policies.label: Federal visa required; KRI permission separate

policies.n: Tourism exemption up to 30 days under the government-adopted expansion of Resolution 134/2018. Complete applicable EASE pre-registration and airport-security-tax requirements; these do not constitute an eVisa and do not grant residence or work permission.

Mongolian passport: all-passport visa-waiver agreement in force from 17 January 2024; up to 90 days according to the current Mongolia MFA outbound schedule. No rolling/annual aggregate specified by that table.

Use the active Bosnia nationality record (official ISO code BA, id150) for an ordinary tourist eVisa; the duplicate legacy Herzegovina alias is inactive. Official flags permit online application and email delivery, and the public eligibility check permits proceeding. Obtain approval before travel and satisfy individual age/gender screening. No fixed permitted stay is established; acceptance at every Libyan region/port is not established.

EU citizen holding a valid ordinary passport: treaty visa exemption up to 90 days in any 180-day period, excluding paid activity. EEAS currently confirms the agreement applies. This is the treaty-specific entitlement; omission from the separate 2023 domestic exemption list is not evidence of treaty termination. Normal entry-permission and travel-document checks remain applicable.
